description: generic offense: fills each slot by position+index, no crash on missing players
empty roster leaves every slot empty, correct slot count, no throw
special teams: explicit playerId resolves; null playerId renders an empty slot
RB-group slot with no tagged RB falls back to the best-ranked FB, relabeled "FB"
real defense 3-4: exact-tag seating puts the real WLB/LILB/RILB/SLB/LDE/NT/RDE players in their named slots even when input order is scrambled
nickel DB seating: LCB/RCB/SS/FS get exact tags, 5th (NB) slot prefers the NB tag over a generic CB
generic-tag defense on the fallback formation (a historical season): every BASE_DEFENSE slot fills from its position group, no side/role tags present
one athlete seated at two positions (DEP-585): a swing tackle holding LT2 and RT1 fills the RT slot as well, and the LT slot still goes to the LT1
a seat pointing at an athlete the roster does not carry is skipped, not faked (DEP-585)
offensive line, granular roster without a depth chart: every line slot seats its exact tag in pass 1, backups stay off the field
offensive line, granular starters with generic OT/G backups: the exact tags still win every slot and the generic backups stay off the field
offensive line, depth-chart seats with a guard doubling as backup center: starters seat on their exact seats
offensive line, coarse 1999-style roster (2 OT, 2 G, 1 C): tackles seat at LT/RT and guards at LG/RG, best-ranked on the left
offensive line, a guard ranked ahead of the lone tackle never takes a tackle slot while that tackle is unseated
offensive line, sided and generic tags mixed: the exact LT seats at LT and the generic OT takes RT
offensive line, short pool (1 OT, 1 C): the remaining line slots stay empty, no player is repeated
offensive line, surplus pool (3 OT, 3 G, 2 C): five distinct linemen seat and the surplus stays off the field
offensive line, no center but spare guards: pass 3 seats the next guard at C after the tackles and guards are placed
secondary, coarse (1 CB, 1 S, 3 DB): tagged corners and safeties seat first, generic DBs fill the empty CB/S slots in slot order, the surplus DB stays off
secondary, nickel with generic DBs (2 CB, 1 S, 3 DB on 4-2-5): the fourth and fifth DB slots take DBs
secondary, fully tagged plus a generic DB backup: every slot seats a tagged player and the DB stays off
secondary, one DB holding two depth-chart seats fills a single empty slot, never two
